title: A call triggers a status report
body_md: If the number of the inserted Nano SIM card is dialled, Pro-finder ends the call automatically and sends a status report to the caller. The source restricts this to authorised numbers.
prev_context: Before this stands the introduction to the operating modes.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 9: equivalent in substance. How the device recognises an authorised number is stated in neither version; the gap is named rather than filled.
